title: Desk Q&A on Funds-Out Days Before a Settlement Agent Return — Closing and Funding Late-Funding Refunds
content:
**Rule.** Days on which funds were out are treated as follows for a Closing and Funding late-funding refund:

- where the settlement agent returned through its own error the wire that went out on the estimated funding date and the return came in after the closing method's funding request cutoff time, the days from the estimated funding date through the return date, both counted, are taken out, because funds back after the cutoff could not be sent again that day;
- where the settlement agent returned that wire through its own error and the return came in no later than the funding request cutoff time, the days from the estimated funding date up to the day before the return date are taken out;
- otherwise no day is taken out for funds that were out.

A late day that the treatment of funds that were out takes out is not refunded, and the refunded days are never fewer than zero.

A return counts as the settlement agent's own error when it is a wire return marked as a settlement agent rejection and the returned wire's amount equals the amount of the wire that funded the loan (the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date); a returned wire whose amount differs carried Larkspur's wrong amount, and its days are not taken out of a late-funding refund. The wire a return sent back is the outgoing wire the return names; it is the wire that went out on the estimated funding date when that outgoing wire is dated the estimated funding date. The return's date and time are the date and time recorded on the wire return. The funding request cutoff time is 12:00 US Eastern under every closing method (Larkspur Traditional Wet, Escrow Dry-Funding, Mobile Notary, Hybrid eClosing, Remote Online Notarization, Power of Attorney and Mail-Away).

## Questions answered

**A wire went out on the estimated funding date, Monday the 10th, and the settlement agent rejected it through its own error on Wednesday the 12th at 15:10. Which days are taken out?** The return came in after 12:00, so the 10th through the 12th, both counted: 3 days.

**The same return came in at 11:00 on the 12th?** The return came in no later than 12:00, so the 10th and the 11th: 2 days.

**The return came in at exactly 12:00?** That is no later than the cutoff: the days up to the day before the return date.

**No wire went out on the estimated funding date, or the rejected wire's amount differed from the funding wire?** No day is taken out for funds that were out.
